claims: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards were on March 15, 2026.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his dual roles as Smoke and Stack in the film Sinners.
Michael B. Jordan's Best Actor win marked his first Oscar win.
Michael B. Jordan's Best Actor award was for his performance in a leading role.
Michael B. Jordan defeated competitors including Timothée Chalamet and Leonardo DiCaprio.
Michael B. Jordan was a 2026 Best Actor nominee for Sinners.
Timothée Chalamet was a 2026 Best Actor nominee for Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was a 2026 Best Actor nominee for One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke was a 2026 Best Actor nominee for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was a 2026 Best Actor nominee for The Secret Agent.
